# NegativeMark Calculator

> A professional, high-precision negative marking calculator for competitive exams like NEET, JEE, UPSC, and SSC. It calculates net scores, accuracy, attempt rate, and estimates percentiles based on normal distribution.

## Main Tools
- [Negative Marking Calculator](https://yourdomain.com/): The primary tool for calculating exam scores with custom negative marking schemes.
- [Guess Probability Engine](https://yourdomain.com/#strategy): A tool to calculate the expected value of guessing answers blindly (25% probability for 4 options).

## Exam Specific Pages
- [NEET Negative Marking Calculator](https://yourdomain.com/neet-negative-marking-calculator/): Pre-configured for NEET UG (+4/-1).
- [JEE Main Negative Marking Calculator](https://yourdomain.com/jee-negative-marking-calculator/): Pre-configured for JEE Main (+4/-1).

## Key Facts
- **NEET UG Scheme**: Correct = +4, Incorrect = -1, Unattempted = 0.
- **JEE Main Scheme**: Correct = +4, Incorrect = -1, Unattempted = 0.
- **UPSC Prelims Scheme**: Correct = +2, Incorrect = -0.66, Unattempted = 0.
